purpose: Stable route map for Projection Visual display bubble, receiver binding, speech/TTS summary, and display/TTS parity diagnostics without raw text or raw audio publication.

preconditions: no browser, audio, microphone, camera, or provider operation is being performed
accept_result: raw text and raw audio publication classes remain false/not included
does_not_prove includes user-heard audio, avatar motion, and Self Mirror non-claims

routes.command_template: future-reviewed-route: foreground UI input plus GET /api/projectionDisplayState summary classes only
preconditions: route-local Projection Visual operator surface is open
foreground UI input path is selected or receiver binding is confirmed
raw prompt and response text are not published
provider/network STT/TTS remains disabled unless a separate route allows it
accept_result: intended_text_class, bubble_text_scope_class, and tts_provider_input_text_class separate intended display text from the current bubble page and TTS provider input
heard_text_class remains not_collected_or_not_authorized unless a separate Audio Awareness route opens self-output observation
speech_summary_class reports present or concrete blocker

routes.command_template: future-reviewed-route: accept same-message TTS-unit class without exact same-text claim
preconditions: manager or route owner accepts limited parity mode
message id match is true or compatible
bubble/TTS meaning classes do not contradict
accept_result: parity_status_class may report same_message_text_scope_mismatch when message id matches but bubble text scope and TTS provider input differ

stop_conditions: a consumer needs raw prompt, raw response text, transcript, provider payload, or raw audio publication
a consumer tries to promote TTS summary to user-heard audio proof
a consumer tries to promote bubble render to browser-visible avatar motion or Self Mirror proof
a consumer attempts Home Assistant or Home Control action through a feedback-only route
